tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Monday Night Football closes Week 8: Chicago is 5-2 with Caleb Williams back from his hamstring injury, and newly acquired Jeffery Simmons is expected to debut, while Seattle is 4-3 behind a defense that leads the league in yards allowed. Seattle is banged up where it hurts — left tackle Charles Cross and receiver Rashid Shaheed are out, Uchenna Nwosu is doubtful — and Chicago is without running back Kyle Monangai and tight end Cole Kmet for the season. No true edge here at US prices: Chicago +153 is the closest number to fair, Seattle -175 is further away. Weather is no factor in Seattle, cloudy and calm around 50 degrees at kickoff with no rain in the forecast and no weather alerts.
games.title: Chicago @ Seattle
games.verdict: LEAN: Chicago — no true edge, but the lean is Chicago because +153 is the closest price to fair.

games.take: The early marquee game: Cleveland is the home favorite, but no US price beats the devigged Pinnacle fair on either side. Oklahoma City +154 is the least-bad number on the board, Cleveland -175 is further from fair, so the lean goes to the road underdog even though this is not a board play. No true edge here — the take is the price gap, not a matchup call.
games.title: Oklahoma City @ Cleveland
games.verdict: LEAN: Oklahoma City — no true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma City because +154 is the closest price to fair.

games.take: The biggest favorite on the slate, and a real edge: New York -900 at FanDuel beats a 90.9% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.0% EV while DraftKings hangs -980 and BetRivers -910. Brooklyn is 1-5 and without Egor Demin; New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle) but at home at Madison Square Garden. This one is on the board — a steep lay, priced honestly, not a bargain to celebrate.
games.title: Brooklyn @ New York
games.venue: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
games.verdict: LEAN: New York -900 — a real edge, because FanDuel is 80 cents short of DraftKings on the home favorite.

games.our_fair: Orlando 58.9% / Washington 41.1% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); spread fair 52.3%
games.take: The spread is the edge in this one: Orlando -2.5 at -106 (FanDuel) beats a 52.3% devigged Pinnacle spread fair for +1.6% EV while DraftKings hangs -113 and BetRivers -110. Washington travels shorthanded — Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Tristan Vukcevic are out, Alex Sarr is day-to-day with a knee issue — and Orlando is at home at Kia Center. This one is on the board.
games.title: Washington @ Orlando
games.verdict: LEAN: Orlando -2.5 — a real edge, because FanDuel is 7 cents short of DraftKings on the home favorite.

games.take: The moneyline is the edge here: Memphis -178 at FanDuel beats a 64.7% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.1% EV while DraftKings hangs -196 and BetRivers -215. New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee), with Trey Murphy III day-to-day; Memphis is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL), with Scotty Pippen Jr. and Quinten Post day-to-day. The number, not the matchup, makes this one — and it is on the board.
games.title: New Orleans @ Memphis
games.verdict: LEAN: Memphis -178 — a real edge, because FanDuel is 18 cents short of DraftKings on the home favorite.

games.take: A playoff-feel game in Houston with no board edge: Houston -190 is the least-bad price against a 64.2% fair, Boston +166 is further away. No true edge here at US prices — the lean is Houston because the home favorite's price is closest to the fair number, not because the matchup screams it.
games.title: Boston @ Houston
games.verdict: LEAN: Houston — no true edge, but the lean is Houston because it is the closest price to fair.

games.take: The trap to name honestly: Phoenix +152 clears the EV bar, but only at an offshore book — it does not make the board, because offshore-only numbers don't make the cut. At US prices, Phoenix +129 and Golden State -152 are both on the wrong side of fair, with Golden State the least-bad of the two. No true edge here, but the lean is Golden State because its price is closest to fair.
games.title: Phoenix @ Golden State
games.verdict: LEAN: Golden State — no true edge, but the lean is Golden State because it is the closest price to fair at a US book.

games.take: The late coin flip: the Lakers are a small home favorite and the Pinnacle fair is close to 50-50. No true edge here at US prices — the Lakers -125 is the least-bad number, Miami +114 is a touch further from fair. The lean is the Lakers because the home favorite's price is closest to the fair number.
games.title: Miami @ LA Lakers
games.verdict: LEAN: LA Lakers — no true edge, but the lean is LA Lakers because it is the closest price to fair.
